title: 序系统兵种与大陆战力对照表
content_zh:
某宅男林天穿越到剑魔大陆,在生死关头开启了英雄无敌系统,拥有了召唤系统神赐兵种的能力.在这个剑与魔法的大地上,低调成长.不会出现太过变态的东西,即使是7阶兵种大天使,也只相当于本土的8级大剑师的程度,绝对不可能太过逆天.
看过不少穿越英雄无敌的故事，作为一个英雄无敌系列忠实的老玩家，说不上水品有多高，只有单纯的喜爱，经历过国庆7天都窝在家里单机玩英雄无敌3的疯狂，也经历过等待英雄无敌5的寂寞。随着年龄增长，游戏玩的少了，但始终深爱着这个游戏，如同初恋一般。
也经常逛起点搜寻相关的作品，有不少好的小说故事，这里不一一列举，但始终没找到自己特别想要的那种感觉。所以鼓起了勇气，在起点这个我认为最好的平台上，发表这篇真正原创、完全无抄袭的英雄无敌之召唤千军。赤果果的菜鸟一枚，单纯的热爱，不以赢利为目的。所以不拉票不求推荐，保证文章中不会出现任何与小说无关的内容。
本文不会出现逆天的内容，若你玩过英雄无敌3或者5，你会感觉很熟悉，因为我会尽量保证原味，只有小规模的变化影响不大。若你没玩过英雄无敌系列，也完全不会影响到您的，很多系统小细节作品中都会有简单说明，非常流畅，您一样会感觉很熟悉。
1、作者只是个游戏菜鸟，游戏高手勿扰！
2、作者不是数据帝，全文难免有数据不准确的地方，这不是大家来找碴！请轻喷！
3、有不妥当之处欢迎提出，但即使是批评也请有理有据，无视无脑打压的**。
4、本文系统以英雄无敌3和5为基础，为减少复杂程度无视其他几代。
5、这应该算爽文，但故事有跌宕有起伏，有失败有成功。
6、简化了资源系统，全部现金结算。
7、异界大陆实力为0－10级，而系统里都用阶来划分，简单来说可以这么看，1阶=级别+1=2级。
8、主角有血有肉，有思想有特点，具有严重的宅属性。
9、作者不是专业写手，请轻喷，不还口！
10、故事性方面绝对保证原汁原味，保证更新速度，只在起点发表，绝不太监！;
content_en:
A certain otaku Lin Tian traveled to the Sword Demon Continent, activated the hero invincibility system at the critical moment of life and death, and had the ability to summon the system's god-given troops. In this land of swords and magic, he grew up in a low-key manner. Nothing too abnormal would appear. Even the seventh-level military archangel is only equivalent to the local eighth-level great swordsman, and it is absolutely impossible to be too heaven-defying.
I have read a lot of time travel stories about Heroes of Invincibility. As a loyal old player of the Heroes of Invincibility series, I can’t say how high-quality it is. I only have a simple love for it. I have experienced the madness of staying at home and playing Heroes of Might and Magic 3 on a single player during the 7-day National Day, and I have also experienced the loneliness of waiting for Heroes of Might and Magic 5. As I get older, I play less games, but I still love this game deeply, just like my first love.
I also often visit Qidian to search for related works. There are many good novels and stories, which I won’t list here, but I have never found the feeling I particularly want. So I mustered up the courage to publish this truly original and completely plagiarism-free Heroes of Invincibility: Summoning Thousands Army on Qidian, which I think is the best platform. Chi Guoguo is a newbie, purely out of love, not for the purpose of profit. Therefore, I do not seek votes or recommendations, and I guarantee that there will be no content in the article that is not related to the novel.
This article will not contain any outrageous content. If you have played Heroes 3 or 5, you will feel very familiar with it, because I will try to keep the original flavor as much as possible, and only small-scale changes will have little impact. If you have never played the Invincible Heroes series, it will not affect you at all. Many small details of the system will be briefly explained in the works, which is very smooth and you will feel very familiar with it.
1. The author is just a game novice, game masters please don’t bother!
2. The author is not a data king. There will inevitably be inaccuracies in the full text. This is not something everyone is looking for! Please spray lightly!
3. If there is anything inappropriate, you are welcome to raise it, but even if you criticize, please be well-founded and ignore the ** of mindless suppression.
4. The system in this article is based on Heroes 3 and 5, and ignores other generations in order to reduce complexity.
5. This should be considered a cool article, but the story has ups and downs, failures and successes.
6. The resource system is simplified and all settlements are made in cash.
7. The strength of the alien continent is level 0-10, and the system is divided by levels. To put it simply, it can be seen like this, level 1 = level + 1 = level 2.
8. The protagonist has flesh and blood, thoughts and characteristics, and a serious otaku attribute.
9. The author is not a professional writer, so please be gentle and don’t talk back!
10. The story is absolutely guaranteed to be original and the update speed is guaranteed. It will only be published at the starting point and will never be supervised! ;
